# Portable Component Reference

Use `app-layout.blade.php` as the root shell; `dashboard.blade.php`, `listing.blade.php`, and `form.blade.php` as pattern fragments; `bizlite-tokens.css` for visual values; and `theme-interactions.js` for only the documented shell behaviors. The snippets assume the management Blade components described in `04-COMPONENT-LIBRARY.md` have been created in the target project.

Keep class names (`kpi-grid`, `kpi-card`, `t-card`, `t-hdr`, `input-icon-left`, `btn-ic`) stable and supply corresponding CSS from the original token/theme layer. These are references, not an extracted production package.
